name: Eiger Bike Challenge 20 km

routeMethod: Resample at 5 m with approximately 40 m altitude smoothing; preserve interior GPX corner vertices when a short chord would cause a false steep grade. Road, HUD, physics and trainer share the same profile. Original 35.48 m finish/start gap retained; no artificial closing connector.
sectorMethod: Three app-defined training starts, not official timed sectors

visualLimitations: Summer materials, vegetation species, spectators and race furniture are interpretations. Reference photos are not bundled as textures.
